skippedMediumNoCore.name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Zogeria bay, NW Spetses, has two coves; guides (argosaronikos.gr, travelgo) place the taverna and the rented umbrella/sunbed sets (10€/σετ) in the bay, with the small cove specifically holding the taverna and sunbeds. Caveat: some sources describe the bay as a whole, so attribution to the small cove is good but not airtight.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Ζέφυρος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Disambiguated from the Rhodes namesake: Zefiros is the cafe/beach bar ON the Nea Artaki beach (eviagreece.gr item, e-chalkida video 'Παραλία Ζέφυρος - Νέα Αρτάκη'). Sources on the Nea Artaki beachfront describe beachfront bars with umbrellas and sunbeds (extra charge for sunbeds on weekends), with Zefiros named as the beachfront venue at this spot.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Δάφνης
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Disambiguated to Dafni Nerotrivias (west-coast central Evia, matches pin 38.63/23.49; the other Dafni is at Chiliadou on the Aegean side). eviaportal's beach-specific page: a seasonal 'beach bar με εστιατόριο' operates on the first section and 'βγάζει μερικές ομπρέλες' when open, plus a taverna on the second section — but it advises bringing your own gear and never mentions ξαπλώστρες. Beach bar confirmed; sunbeds unconfirmed and organization is partial/seasonal.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Σουβάλα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Disambiguated from the Aegina namesake: our pin matches Πλαζ Σουβάλα at Chalkida's north port (YouTube 'Χαλκίδα Παραλία (Πλαζ Σουβάλα)', egnomi coverage, official bathing-water profile GRBW079155162). The bathing-water profile states part of the beach is organized with permanent umbrellas, showers and bins (municipal-style). No sunbed-rental or beach-bar evidence.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Αγίου Μηνά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Locality certain: Agios Minas at Genimakia, Desfina — the Corinthian-gulf cove between Chiliadou and Monastiraki, matching our pin. The local municipal-community site e-desfina.gr states a canteen with the emblematic name «Ο ΑΓΙΟΣ» operates on the beach offering everything 'από νερό μέχρι ξαπλώστρα'. This local, beach-specific source outweighs the generic 'δεν θα βρεις beach bar ή ομπρέλες' guide line; sunbeds are canteen-run and seasonal, no beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Λύκος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Unambiguous locality: Lykos/Likkos bay, Sfakia south coast between Loutro and Marmara (matches lat/lng). Taverna Akrogiali sits directly on Lykos beach and its listings state it 'offers sunbeds'; Georgoshouse (also on the bay) advertises free sunbeds and hammocks adjoining the beach. Sunbeds are taverna/guesthouse-provided rather than a concession, and cretanbeaches confirms only tavernas with rooms — no beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Θανάσης
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pinned via lat/lng to the western beach of Stavros, Akrotiri Chania — documented as 'beach near Taverna Thanasis, Stavros, Akrotiri peninsula' (Alamy caption confirms the name/place pairing). Multiple guides (cretanbeaches, elizabethestateagency) state Stavros has two sandy beaches 'organized with canteens, umbrellas and sun beds'. Sunbeds inferred for this specific (Thanasis/western) beach from that two-beach statement, hence not high confidence.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Βουρλιά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Lat/lng matches Vourlia, the central-settlement beach of Xerokambos. Cretanbeaches (a reputable Crete guide, upgrading round-1's 'low-quality map listing') describes the Vourlia settlement beach as 'αρκετά οργανωμένη' (fairly organized) and lists umbrellas among the beach's amenities; tavernas are in the settlement. No explicit sunbed count, hence sunbeds left null and confidence medium.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Unambiguous locality (Chiona, 2 km from Palaikastro, Sitia — matches lat/lng). Resolving the round-1 conflict: cretazine and crete-today both state the beach has 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' (a few sunbeds and umbrellas) plus tamarisks, and famous fish tavernas directly on the beach (e.g. Chiona tavern). So lightly but genuinely organized: few sunbeds yes, no beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άη Γιαννάκης
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Ai Giannakis on the Parga–Preveza road, 6 km before Parga (matches lat/lng). Two dedicated pages (taxidologio.gr, travelpreveza.gr) state it is 'οργανωμένη, με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και θαλάσσια σπορ' with food businesses very close. One round-1 source claimed only a canteen above the beach; the more specific dedicated beach pages win, but the conflict caps confidence at medium.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παντοκράτορας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pantokratoras town beach, 2.5 km from Preveza centre (matches lat/lng). Official/local sources (visitpreveza.gr, prevezaguide) state the beach has some umbrellas and showers, free sunbeds for bathers, and a restaurant and cafeteria right by the sea. Minimal but explicit on-beach organization; the food venues are beside the beach, not a beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Καραβόμυλος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pin matches Karavomilos village beach at Sami. Kefaloniaguide's page for this exact beach (main beach of Sami, next to the lake mill) says visitors can use provided sun loungers and umbrellas; the beachfront Ionian Emerald resort area also keeps loungers/umbrellas on the beach. No distinct beach bar confirmed.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Αγία Βαρβάρα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pin matches Agia Varvara, the main Katelios beach. Beach-specific sources (WonderGreece Katelios–Agia Varvara, kefaloniabyanna, kefalonia.ws) say sunbeds/umbrellas are available for hire on the main section — often taverna-run — while the far turtle-nesting section past the stream is undeveloped. Partly organized overall; sunbeds confirmed, no standalone beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Νότια Παραλία Νικιάνας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pin (38.758, 20.721) = southern stretch of Nikiana towards Episkopos, Lefkada. amazinglefkada: 'just about enough room for one row of sunbeds along most of the beach, belonging to the hotels behind' plus a beach cantina renting sunbeds/umbrellas; the adjacent Episkopos-Nikiana beach immediately south is well organized with sunbed pairs and a beach bar (Greeka). Sunbeds present on the south stretch; dedicated beach bar not confirmed for this exact strip.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Μαδράκια
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pin matches Madrakia by the port of Agios Nikolaos (Volimes), Zakynthos. Beach-specific pages (Greeka Madrakia, beaches-searcher) describe the small sandy stretch by the family-run Madrakia Taverna with 'basic amenities, such as deckchairs & umbrellas, beach bars, toilets'. Sunbeds confirmed; food is the shoreline taverna.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Κατσούνι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Disambiguated to Psara (pin at the settlement's east side; Rhodes/Anafi namesakes excluded). Psara-specific pages (WonderGreece Psara Katsouni, greecevacationsearch Psara entry) describe it as the island's most popular sandy beach with sunbeds, WC and parking, hosting summer beach-volley tournaments. No beach bar confirmed.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Μπάλος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Balos in Ormos Koumeikon, SW Samos (pin matches; Crete namesake excluded). The official Greek bathing-water profile for this exact beach (GRBW149264276) states a section is organized with umbrellas, loungers, changing rooms and bins; samosin.gr's older 'not organized, tavernas on the road' conflicts but the official beach-specific profile is more authoritative. Tavernas are roadside, no beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Σιδερώνα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Siderona near Korfos, Korinthia (pin matches). Beach-specific Greek sources: 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα' whose fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — the taverna puts a few umbrellas and sunbeds on the shore. Sunbeds genuinely present (taverna-run, limited); no beach bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Κολώνα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Kythnos Kolona unambiguous (isthmus to Agios Loukas islet). Recent specific reports: one section rents umbrellas/sunbeds at €30 for 2 front-row / €20 back row, plus a taverna above the beach and a café-snack beach bar. Older guides still say 'not organized, bring equipment' — the priced, operator-specific recent account wins per recency/specificity; main sandy isthmus remains free.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Αλυκή
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Coordinate disambiguation corrected round1: lat 36.108/lng 27.730 is the WEST coast below Monolithos, Rhodes — matching Greeka's 'Just below the village of Monolithos, about 75 km southwest of Rhodes Town'. Greeka: 'Alyki Beach is unorganized, however you will find a handful of sunbeds available for rent'; Tripadvisor reviews confirm 'a dozen umbrellas with sunbeds for rent' run by a named manager. 'No shops or canteens in the area' — sunbed/umbrella rental yes, no bar/canteen. Minimal operation (a dozen sets).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Διόνι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Dioni at Katochi/Acheloos mouth (Oiniades) — agriniopress cites 'the beach bar Navagio' as a main draw, and 'Mammos Beach Bar Dioni Katochi' operates there since 2022 (its own Facebook page). Beach bar confirmed at this exact locality; no explicit sunbed evidence (local article mentions only sandy/shallow), so sunbeds left null.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Πάλτση
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pelioxenia's dedicated Paltsi page (SE Pelion 13km from Argalasti, matches pin): 'During July and August, you'll find sunbeds and parasols available, along with open tavernas serving fresh seafood' — explicit seasonal sunbeds plus two tavernas behind the beach. No beach bar documented; organized = seasonal sunbeds + tavernas only.
